reviews.author: Ananya Sharma
reviews.comment: The craftsmanship is otherworldly. Holding it against the sunlight reveals every minute dried petal and the gold flakes float like stardust. The packaging with raw linen and hand-signed artisan card made unboxing feel like receiving a precious heirloom.

reviews.author: Rohan Mehra
reviews.comment: Commissioned this as an anniversary gift. The crystal clarity is unbelievable—zero bubbles, razor-sharp geometric facets, and the crimson rose looks as fresh as the day it was plucked. Truly bespoke art that commands attention on my study table.

reviews.author: Pooja Iyer
reviews.comment: I was worried statement earrings would feel heavy on my ears, but they are miraculously lightweight! The emerald marbling has so much depth and the gold veins sparkle subtly under evening lighting. Received endless compliments at a gallery opening.

reviews.author: Devika Singhania
reviews.comment: These are too gorgeous to just be coasters—they are miniature paintings on my marble console. The liquid gold edge adds that touch of understated luxury that UNMADE GALLERY excels at. Ordering another pair for my sister!

brandValues.title: Botanicals Captured in Eternity
brandValues.description: We forage wild flora at the exact apex of their seasonal blooming, hand-dehydrating each petal over weeks before encapsulating them in crystal suspension.

brandValues.title: Zero-Bubble Optical Casting
brandValues.description: Every creation undergoes multi-stage vacuum degassing and slow 72-hour thermal curing to achieve water-like transparency and zero internal clouding.

brandValues.title: 24K Gold & Precious Metals
brandValues.description: We integrate genuine 24-karat gold leaf flakes, antique brass, and hypoallergenic titanium findings ensuring lasting luxury that respects sensitive skin.

brandValues.title: Unrepeatable Individuality
brandValues.description: Because every flower petal is unique and resin flows with natural fluid dynamics, no two pieces across the globe will ever be identical.
